title: I1: First Drop Detection
description: Intermediate lesson: Find the moment patient started to deteriorate - first SpO2 crossing below 94%

queries.label: First Drop Query
queries.sql:
WITH tagged AS (
    SELECT
        event_time,
        spo2_pct,
        LAG(spo2_pct, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY patient_id
            ORDER BY event_time
        ) AS previous_spo2
    FROM lake.lakehouse.vitals
    WHERE patient_id = '55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555555'
)
SELECT
    event_time,
    ROUND(previous_spo2, 1) AS spo2_before,
    ROUND(spo2_pct, 1)      AS spo2_after
FROM tagged
WHERE previous_spo2 >= 94 AND spo2_pct < 94
ORDER BY event_time
